fields.label: Person
fields.description: The normal path — links this stakeholder row directly to a User (this IS their login, no separate identity record). Party Name/Organization/Email/Phone below are filled from it automatically — Organization by whether this User is a Portal User of a Customer or Supplier (see EGC Stakeholder Role). Only fill the fields directly for a one-off party that genuinely has no User yet.

fields.label: Organization Type
fields.description: Dynamic Link validates `organization` against this BEFORE the row's own validate() runs (same ordering as `party_name`'s reqd check) — a field-level default, not a controller default, is the only thing early enough. `fetch_from_person()` overwrites it once `person` resolves to an actual Customer/Supplier/neither. "Other" is a deliberately ad-hoc, non-Customer/Supplier organization — `organization_label` (plain text) is used instead of `organization`/the Dynamic Link in that case, and is never fetched from `person`.

fields.label: Organization
fields.description: A free-text organization name for a party that isn't (and shouldn't become) a Customer/Supplier record — e.g. a one-off consultant firm you don't want in your Sales/Purchase master data.
